intro.text: A small, rare flying crustacean with silver eyes and an axehound-like face, whose corpses are highly prized.
Small, highly valued flying crustaceans from Aimia that can consume Stormlight and other Investiture. Called the Ancient Guardians, they once guarded the Dawnshard.

description.text: Larkin look somewhat like cremlings, but with small axehound-like faces, solid silver eyes, and wings that fold out of their backs, strong enough for short flights.

They can suck Stormlight out of Surgebinders, gems and dead Shardplate, the Light streaming visibly into their mouths, and can even drain Voidlight from a Fused. Chiri-Chiri grows noticeably after a big feed.
To grow large a larkin must bond a big kind of luckspren found only on Aimia. Most now stay small, and Chiri-Chiri is the only one known in a long time to do so.
Larkin can hear rhythms, like singers, understand human languages and crudely imitate them.

items.text: Elhokar keeps a larkin's corpse encased in crystal as a paperweight. Since Aimia's scouring larkin are so rare that Shallan thinks of the phrase "rare as a larkin".
Vstim trades a great deal for a larkin's corpse, and Rysn is given a live one, which she names Chiri-Chiri.
Larkin once guarded the Dawnshard on Aimia, earning the name Ancient Guardians. After they vanished from Aimia the Sleepless took over the task, still revering them.
